summary: Fish Audio offers s2.1-pro-free — the same TTS model as the paid S2.1-Pro — at $0 for development, testing, prototyping, and smaller businesses. Same quality and 83-language coverage as s2.1-pro, under fair-use limits, with no TTFA or DPA guarantees and no published end date.
claim_steps: Create an account and API key at fish.audio.
Use the s2.1-pro-free model string with the standard TTS API endpoint.
